processing.description: Read the article's JATS XML from Europe PMC (sha256 727b62b8c073…) and checked its DOI, the caption and column headers of Table 3 and 2 sentences of the text.

Published the mean and the median price per kilogram of the four product groups, with the minimum and maximum as the range: 8 values, each addressed by its printed row label and column header and published as printed.
Nothing was subtracted: plant-based and conventional prices are shown side by side as the table gives them.

published_value.quote: Table 3. Descriptive indicators for price per kilogram (kg) for each product group in euro (EUR).

scope.basis: Shelf prices observed in May 2022, recalculated per kilogram from price and pack mass; statistics across the products observed. Conventional meat is not split by species.
scope.geography: Vienna, Austria: the nationwide supermarket chains Billa, Billa Plus, Spar/Eurospar/Interspar, Hofer and Lidl

title: Price of plant-based and conventional mince and sausages in Vienna (Falkenberg et al. 2023)
